name: Daily KPI digest

parameters.content:
## Daily KPI digest
SQL query → KPIs in code → AI writes 5 lines → number check → chat.

**Guards:** the KPIs are computed in code, never by the model · every number in the AI text must match a computed fact (rounding allowed) and there must be exactly five lines · otherwise the template summary is posted.

**AI off:** template summary.

nodes.name: Load sample data
nodes.notes: Invented, labelled items served by the mock services

nodes.name: Query sales
nodes.notes: Read-only SQL, grouped by day, channel, status and product

nodes.name: AI switched on?
nodes.notes: Off: the rule-based path handles everything

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sample_id: $json.sample_id, report_date: $json.report_date, text: $json.message.text, blocks: $json.message.blocks, summary_source: $json.summary_source }) }}

nodes.name: Post to #daily-kpis
nodes.notes: Slack-format message to the chat webhook

description: Every morning: queries yesterday's sales, computes the KPIs, has AI write a five-line summary, checks every number in it against the query result, and posts the digest to the team chat.
